info.title: Dynatrace Account Management API
info.description: The enterprise management API for Dynatrace SaaS enables automation of operational tasks related to user access and environment lifecycle management.

tags.name: User management
tags.description: Manage users in an account and their group memberships.

tags.name: Group management
tags.description: Create and manage user groups and their members.

tags.name: Policy management
tags.description: Manage IAM policies, policy bindings, and permission boundaries.

tags.name: Account limits
tags.description: Retrieve the limits configured for an account.

tags.name: Service user management
tags.description: Manage service users within an account.

tags.name: Platform tokens

tags.name: Workload Identity Federation
tags.description: Manage workload identity federation trust policies and their service-user mappings.

tags.name: Environment management
tags.description: List environments and clusters and manage their IP allowlist configuration.

tags.name: Quota management

tags.name: Dynatrace Platform Subscription
tags.description: View platform subscriptions and their usage, cost, forecast, and rate-card data.

tags.name: Reference data
tags.description: Look up reference data such as time zones, regions, and available permissions.

tags.name: Partner Accounts
tags.description: For environments that are managed by Dynatrace partners, this API provides access to the partner accounts and their associated environments.
